name: The Sol Reclamation
description: Repair the station's defense grid by recovering a Sol Unit.

talk_to_warden.label: Talk to Warden Holt
talk_to_warden.description: Find Warden Holt in the outpost entrance.

get_weapon.label: Get a Weapon
get_weapon.description: Head to the munitions depot and get a weapon from Quartermaster Voss.

talk_to_engineer.label: Talk to the Engineer
talk_to_engineer.description: Visit the workshop and speak with the Sol Engineer.

find_warlord_key.label: Defeat the Warlord
find_warlord_key.description: Descend to the deepest level of the quarantine wing and defeat the luddite warlord.

open_supply_crate.label: Open the Supply Crate
open_supply_crate.description: Backtrack to level 2 and use the warlord's key on the locked supply crate.

return_to_engineer.label: Return to the Engineer
return_to_engineer.description: Bring the titanium cylinders back to the workshop.

equip_damage_booster.label: Equip the Damage Booster
equip_damage_booster.description: Open your Sol Grid and place the Damage Booster next to the Sol Cone.

training_range.label: Complete Sol Training
training_range.description: Head to the training range and destroy the targets.

charge_sol_unit.label: Charge your Sol Unit
charge_sol_unit.description: Head to the Power Station to charge the Sol Unit.

cross_perimeter.label: Cross the Dark Perimeter
cross_perimeter.description: Pass through the perimeter gate and traverse the dangerous outer ring to reach the train station.

get_transit_pass.label: Get a Transit Pass
get_transit_pass.description: Help Tech Yara clear the junction box nest to earn a Transit Pass for the train to Meridian City.

board_train.label: Board the Train to Meridian City
board_train.description: Use your Transit Pass to open the platform gate and board the train.

arrive_meridian.label: Arrive at Meridian City
arrive_meridian.description: You've boarded the train. Ride it to Meridian City and explore the station.

visit_civic_center.label: Visit the Civic Center
visit_civic_center.description: Head east from the station to the Civic Center and meet Land Registrar Hollis.

visit_workshop.label: Visit the Workshop District
visit_workshop.description: Head west from the station to the Workshop District and meet Master Crafter Yun.
